t: Screwdriver set designed for dry environments. Features ergonomic, SoftFinish handle for optimal transmission of hand force whilst minimising strain, with hard and soft zones for secure grip, and roll-off protection. Ideal for professional use.
b: Contents: 2 x slotted electric screwdrivers, 1 x PH electric, 3 x slotted screwdrivers, 2 x PH, 2 x steel cap screwdrivers (1 x slotted 1 x PH ) and 220-250V voltage tester.
